info.title: Harness Law integration API
info.description: Versioned applicant preparation API. Paths are internal Harness Law product contracts, not AWS, OpenAI or USCIS endpoints. Browser requests use the existing Sites session; identity is resolved by trusted server middleware. Do not send client-supplied owner identities or oai-authenticated-* headers. Government submission and P1 reviewer/notification workflows are outside this release. Strict executable request schemas live in lib/integrations/domain.ts; public contracts live in lib/integrations/contracts.ts. A model proposal is never a legal approval probability.

post.summary: Create an authenticated applicant preparation case
post.description: Creates at most one active case per authenticated identity. Ownership, case ID and revision are assigned by the server. Explicit processing consent is required before uploads.

get.summary: Read scoped case status and current result pointers
get.description: Read scoped case status and current result pointers

patch.summary: Grant or withdraw processing consent at the expected case revision
patch.description: Supply the exact expected case revision in the body (including initial revision 0) or a positive If-Match header. Withdrawal cancels queued/running jobs and prevents worker reads, execution and publication, including late commits. Renewed consent permits new work but does not restore canceled jobs. Existing evidence remains accessible to its applicant.

get.description: Authenticated metadata only. Approved prompts and evidence content are not returned.

patch.description: Confirm or revise a fact and invalidate dependent inputs

post.summary: Create a constrained private quarantine upload session
post.description: Limits are 20 MiB and a 15-minute grant. SHA-256, declared size and supported media type are frozen. Upload URL requires the current authenticated session; it is not a public storage URL.

post.summary: Renew the same upload destination and immutable constraints
post.description: Renew the same upload destination and immutable constraints

put.summary: Transfer bytes verified against the upload session
put.description: Checks actual file signatures, byte length and SHA-256. Replaying the same successful transfer key returns its original response, including after confirmation. A new transfer to a closed session is rejected.

post.summary: Verify pinned stored bytes and queue processing
post.description: Reads the exact stored object version again. Creates one quarantined document version and one processing job. No client completion flags or manifests are accepted.

get.description: Quarantined, rejected and removed sources are unavailable. Each read pins the recorded storage version and digest. Subsequent range requests recheck current case access.

patch.description: Expected revision is the link_revision. Removing one link preserves the source and unrelated criterion links. Confirmation alone does not imply evidence support or legal sufficiency.

post.summary: Freeze authorized inputs and dispatch an isolated criterion run
post.description: Requires an approved active module, confirmed links, accepted extracted sources and confirmed required facts. Server assigns manifest hash and generation. Identical current manifests reuse a logical run.

post.summary: Validate a worker-only structured result candidate
post.description: Requires a signed capability for this exact case and run job. Validates required elements, authority references, source versions, locators, generation and current dependencies. An obsolete valid outcome is retained as superseded and returns 409 stale_run. Applicant credentials cannot publish.

post.summary: Execute one job using a short-lived job capability
post.description: The HMAC capability binds the exact case_id, job_id and expiry (at most 15 minutes). Durable job leases and checkpoints deduplicate execution. The operation has no JSON body requirement. No applicant session is accepted as worker authority.

get.description: Read an exact immutable result revision

post.description: Record applicant review for the expected result revision

post.summary: Assemble exact selected result revisions and visible unresolved tasks
post.description: Selected result revisions must be current and match their criterion. A missing selected result remains an unresolved task. Case-wide sources/facts are separately selected. Server computes the immutable input digest and dependency map.

post.summary: Dispatch missing selected criteria and assemble a pinned working composition
post.description: Uses the same criterion and composition controllers. Creates a composition from explicitly selected result revisions, dispatches missing selected criteria when their inputs are ready, and reports criterion-specific blockers. Unresolved criteria remain visible in the pinned composition; later completed results are never silently adopted.

get.summary: Read composition, dependency freshness and private tasks
get.description: Read composition, dependency freshness and private tasks

patch.description: Requires approved case-wide rule configuration and citations within explicitly selected case-wide evidence. Criteria route needs overall_record, continued_work and prospective_benefit sections; major_award route additionally needs major_award. New claims require applicant support review.

Records an applicant decision and reason against an exact draft revision. Shared passages or repeated proposed event IDs are review signals. Unresolved event groups block export; a same-event decision does not represent repeated claims as independent achievements.

patch.summary: Record an applicant disposition of a frozen result issue
patch.description: Expected revision is the composed draft_revision. Missing-evidence tasks and contradictions remain frozen with their exact selected result revisions. A resolved or acknowledged disposition records the applicant, reason and issue revision, increments the draft revision and retains prior disposition history. It does not erase adverse evidence or certify legal sufficiency. Outstanding issues block packet creation; reviewed issues and original result bundles remain in its frozen snapshot.

patch.summary: Save a paragraph with revision conflict and support invalidation
patch.description: Expected revision is the composed draft_revision. Material text changes reset support_status to needs_review and review_status to unreviewed; historical decisions remain attached to prior revisions.

post.description: Record applicant review for a composed paragraph

get.summary: Resolve a citation within its exact result or composition revision
get.description: Supply result_id + result_revision, or composition_id + draft_revision. The server checks the citation context and exact source artifact, extraction and locator. The viewer_path reauthorizes access on every request.

post.summary: Map confirmed facts into an approved form field preview
post.description: Returns template version/checksum, mapped values and unresolved/overflow/date errors. It does not file a government application. Current implementation returns field data; the packet renderer creates official form pages from pinned template bytes.

post.summary: Create a frozen candidate and asynchronous render job
post.description: Requires current composition, supported reviewed composed claims, resolved selected criteria, case-wide analysis and current form previews. Packet digest and reference manifest are produced by the server/renderer, never the client.

post.description: Rechecks all authoritative dependency revisions at commit time. Later evidence, link, fact, result, rule, form or draft changes reject approval even if invalidation events are delayed. Self-service approval does not require attorney status.

post.description: Always returns 422 reviewer_unavailable for an authorized applicant. No attorney invitation, access grant or notification is sent.

SitesSession.name: Cookie
SitesSession.description: Browser sends its valid Sites-managed session cookies using credentials: same-origin. Cookie names and identity-provider endpoints are managed by Sites and are not defined by this API. Server middleware resolves the session; a client identity header alone is never authorization.

WorkerCapability.description: Short-lived signed {case_id, job_id, expires_at} capability issued by the trusted worker controller; expiry is no later than 15 minutes. Not an applicant access token.

Origin.name: Origin
Origin.description: Must equal the exact request origin for every applicant mutation.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Reusing a key with the same case/actor/operation and canonical payload returns the original response. Changed payload returns 409.

IfMatch.name: If-Match
IfMatch.description: Exact positive expected revision; may replace body expected_revision. Both must agree when supplied. Weak ETags, wildcards and unsafe integers are rejected.

Range.name: Range
Range.description: One byte range only. Supports explicit start/end, open-ended start and nonzero suffix length.

Error401.description: Authentication is absent, invalid or expired.

Error403.description: Same-origin browser mutation or role requirement failed.

Error404.description: Resource unavailable; inaccessible and nonexistent resources are indistinguishable.

Error409.description: Revision, idempotency, source integrity, stale run/composition or packet conflict.

Error413.description: Request or case capacity limit exceeded.

Error416.description: Requested single byte range is invalid or unsatisfiable.

Error422.description: Field validation or preparation dependency blocker.

Error429.description: Case operation limit reached; Retry-After is bounded.
